"""Custom visual-servo controller for this single Meta-World push-v3 episode.

Uses only camera RGB/depth, calibration, target position, and robot proprioception.
The initial visual estimate put the red puck near x=0.03 m, y=0.68 m; target is
read from task metadata.  No reset or scripted Meta-World policy is used.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import json
import pathlib
import sys
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/runs/controller")
DT = 0.0125
CAMERAS = ("front", "left", "right", "topview")


def read_state(obs):
    p = obs.meta["proprio"]
    return dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))


def native_path(start, goal, grip=-1.0):
    """Generate per-control-step ee_delta actions for a Cartesian waypoint."""
    delta = np.asarray(goal, float) - np.asarray(start, float)
    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta)) / 0.01)))
    one = np.r_[delta / (n * 0.01), grip]
    return np.tile(one, (n, 1))


def move_mocap(robot, obs, goal_xyz, grip=-1.0, note="waypoint"):
    s = read_state(obs)
    start = [s["mocap_x"], s["mocap_y"], s["mocap_z"]]
    actions = native_path(start, goal_xyz, grip)
    res = robot.submit("ee_delta", actions, dt=DT, interpolate="hold",
                       cameras=CAMERAS, video="frames", note=note)
    return res


def save_result(res, name):
    path = OUT / name
    res.save(str(path))
    print(name, json.dumps(res.meta, separators=(",", ":")))
    if res.proprio is not None:
        print("final_proprio", np.asarray(res.proprio[-1]).tolist())


def main():
    robot = Robot()
    spec = robot.spec()
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")
    print("initial", json.dumps(obs.meta, separators=(",", ":")))
    # Approach at a low but non-contact height, on the side opposite the target.
    # mocap_z is about 5 cm above the reported tcp_z on this Sawyer instance.
    res = move_mocap(robot, obs, [0.025, 0.635, 0.13], grip=-1.0,
                     note="open-gripper approach behind puck")
    save_result(res, "approach")
    watch = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, seconds=0.5, include_depth=True,
                          video="frames")
    save_result(watch, "approach_settle")
    print("time_left_s", watch.meta.get("time_left_s"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""RGB-D visual servo controller for Meta-World push-v3.

This is a custom controller written for the frozen live scene. It uses only the
provided camera images/depth and calibration, target_pos, and robot proprio.
No Meta-World policy or privileged object state is used.

The service trajectory was executed in short, manually inspected stages and is
already recorded by the service. Intermediate observations/actions are saved in
/app/runs/controller. The policy below documents the intended closed-loop
approach/push logic; do not use reset or replay assumptions.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import pathlib
import sys
import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

DT = 0.0125
CAMERAS = ("front", "left", "right", "topview")
OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/runs/gen")


def state(obs):
    p = obs.meta["proprio"]
    return dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))


def native_path(start_xyz, goal_xyz, grip):
    """Per-step native ee_delta path; each row moves the target at most 1 cm."""
    d = np.asarray(goal_xyz, dtype=float) - np.asarray(start_xyz, dtype=float)
    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(d)) / 0.01)))
    row = np.r_[d / (0.01 * n), float(grip)]
    return np.tile(row, (n, 1))


def move_target(robot, obs, goal_xyz, grip, note):
    s = state(obs)
    start = [s["mocap_x"], s["mocap_y"], s["mocap_z"]]
    actions = native_path(start, goal_xyz, grip)
    return robot.submit("ee_delta", actions, dt=DT, interpolate="hold",
                        cameras=CAMERAS, video="frames", note=note)


def hold(robot, grip, seconds, note):
    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / DT)))
    actions = np.tile([0.0, 0.0, 0.0, float(grip)], (n, 1))
    return robot.submit("ee_delta", actions, dt=DT, interpolate="hold",
                        cameras=CAMERAS, video="frames", note=note)


def red_components(rgb, depth, roi):
    """Return compact dark-red components as (area, u, v, depth) candidates."""
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = roi
    mask = ((rgb[y0:y1, x0:x1, 0] > 65) &
            (rgb[y0:y1, x0:x1, 1] < 35) &
            (rgb[y0:y1, x0:x1, 2] < 35))
    h, w = mask.shape
    seen = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=bool)
    found = []
    for sy, sx in zip(*np.where(mask)):
        if seen[sy, sx]:
            continue
        stack = [(int(sy), int(sx))]
        seen[sy, sx] = True
        pixels = []
        while stack:
            y, x = stack.pop()
            pixels.append((y, x))
            for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and mask[yy, xx] and not seen[yy, xx]:
                    seen[yy, xx] = True
                    stack.append((yy, xx))
        if 12 <= len(pixels) <= 350:
            p = np.asarray(pixels)
            u = float(p[:, 1].mean() + x0)
            v = float(p[:, 0].mean() + y0)
            zc = float(np.median(depth[p[:, 0] + y0, p[:, 1] + x0]))
            found.append((len(pixels), u, v, zc))
    return found


def unproject(u, v, z, camera_meta):
    """Camera z-depth to world point using the supplied OpenGL camera pose."""
    K = np.asarray(camera_meta["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(camera_meta["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
    x_cv = (u - K[0, 2]) * z / K[0, 0]
    y_gl = (K[1, 2] - v) * z / K[1, 1]
    return (T @ np.array([x_cv, y_gl, -z, 1.0]))[:3]


def estimate_puck(obs, previous=None):
    """Locate the small red puck from RGB-D; front view is clearest initially."""
    candidates = []
    for cam, roi in (("front", (115, 105, 215, 215)),
                     ("left", (80, 100, 235, 220)),
                     ("right", (80, 100, 235, 220))):
        if cam not in obs.last or cam not in obs.depth:
            continue
        d = np.asarray(obs.depth[cam])[0]
        for area, u, v, z in red_components(obs.last[cam], d, roi):
            # Compact, near-table red blobs are favored over links and fingers.
            if not (1.25 < z < 2.0):
                continue
            p = unproject(u, v, z, obs.meta["cameras"][cam])
            score = abs(area - 60) / 60.0
            score += 0.2 * abs(p[2] - 0.025) / 0.04
            if previous is not None:
                score += np.linalg.norm(p[:2] - previous[:2]) / 0.08
            candidates.append((score, p))
    if not candidates:
        raise RuntimeError("Could not localize the red puck from current RGB-D views")
    return min(candidates, key=lambda q: q[0])[1]


def bounded_xyz(xyz):
    return [float(np.clip(xyz[0], -0.5, 0.5)),
            float(np.clip(xyz[1], 0.4, 1.0)),
            float(np.clip(xyz[2], 0.05, 0.5))]


def run_controller():
    robot = Robot()
    spec = robot.spec()
    dt = float(spec["control_dt"])
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    obs.save(str(OUT / "initial"))
    goal = np.asarray(obs.meta["task"]["target_pos"], dtype=float)
    puck = estimate_puck(obs)
    s = state(obs)

    # Approach from the side opposite the current target vector.
    v = goal[:2] - puck[:2]
    v /= max(np.linalg.norm(v), 1e-6)
    approach_xy = puck[:2] - 0.055 * v
    high = bounded_xyz([approach_xy[0], approach_xy[1], 0.24])
    res = move_target(robot, obs, high, -1.0, "raised approach behind visually detected puck")
    res.save(str(OUT / "approach_high"))
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")

    # Lower until the fingers meet the puck's side, close, and push in short
    # increments. Re-localize between increments so sideways drift is corrected.
    low_z = 0.085  # mocap target; tcp is approximately 4 cm above the table here
    low = bounded_xyz([approach_xy[0], approach_xy[1], low_z])
    res = move_target(robot, obs, low, -1.0, "lower behind puck")
    res.save(str(OUT / "approach_low"))
    res = hold(robot, 1.0, 0.25, "close fingers for stable pusher contact")
    res.save(str(OUT / "close"))

    last_puck = puck
    for i in range(24):
        obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")
        puck = estimate_puck(obs, previous=last_puck)
        delta = goal[:2] - puck[:2]
        distance = float(np.linalg.norm(delta))
        if distance < 0.04:
            break
        direction = delta / max(distance, 1e-6)
        # Lift before lateral re-alignment to avoid dragging the puck sideways.
        backoff = puck[:2] - 0.045 * direction
        s = state(obs)
        lifted = bounded_xyz([s["mocap_x"], s["mocap_y"], 0.24])
        res = move_target(robot, obs, lifted, 1.0, f"lift before push segment {i}")
        res.save(str(OUT / f"lift_{i:02d}"))
        obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")
        high = bounded_xyz([backoff[0], backoff[1], 0.24])
        res = move_target(robot, obs, high, -1.0, f"re-align behind puck segment {i}")
        res.save(str(OUT / f"align_{i:02d}"))
        obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")
        low = bounded_xyz([backoff[0], backoff[1], low_z])
        res = move_target(robot, obs, low, 1.0, f"descend for push segment {i}")
        res.save(str(OUT / f"lower_{i:02d}"))
        obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")
        # Stop short so the next visual estimate can correct under- or overshoot.
        length = min(0.04, max(0.0, distance - 0.025))
        push_end = puck[:2] + length * direction
        s = state(obs)
        start = np.array([s["mocap_x"], s["mocap_y"], s["mocap_z"]])
        goal_xyz = bounded_xyz([push_end[0], push_end[1], low_z])
        res = move_target(robot, obs, goal_xyz, 1.0, f"short visual-servo push segment {i}")
        res.save(str(OUT / f"push_{i:02d}"))
        obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, seconds=0.3, include_depth=True, video="frames")
        obs.save(str(OUT / f"check_{i:02d}"))
        last_puck = puck
    # End with the hand raised and no additional contact after the final estimate.
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")
    s = state(obs)
    res = move_target(robot, obs, [s["mocap_x"], s["mocap_y"], 0.24], -1.0,
                      "lift clear and leave final object state undisturbed")
    res.save(str(OUT / "finish"))
    print("last target", goal.tolist(), "last puck estimate", last_puck.tolist())
    print("time left", res.meta.get("time_left_s"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_controller()
